note: Adds emailToReveal/actorEmailToRevealForLogItem and gates the avatar tooltip on it; the tooltip stays inline, no shared avatar component extracted.
Moves aggregation into a new request_usage module with a parse_sdk_breakdown helper; the loop now parses, adds per-SDK counts, and adds the remainder to other.
Adds a memoized for_team_ids method building per-team UserAccessControl instances; none_denied_object_ids is unchanged and takes no predicate.
Removes the batch_failure helper and its test and builds publish results in the Kafka enqueue loop; Sink trait input stays Kafka-shaped.
Drops the live import and defines a frozen VARIANT_ROLLOUT_SUM_TOLERANCE = 1e-9 inside migration 0015; also adds a hash-dependence guard.
Removes the setAccessControlsApply action and its afterMount dispatch; accessControlsApply is now a reducer whose default reads getAppContext().
Renames TransformationGlobalsValidator to TemplateGlobalsValidator with an updated docstring and updates all call sites.
Changes the update() decorator to @approval_gate(list(V2_APPROVAL_ACTIONS)), plus unrelated v2 validation and locking changes.
Deletes the changelog pointer line from compact-instructions.md; the exec command reference already carries it via basic-functionality.md.
Moves the outputs completeness check before the broker ping and downgrades its log to info; the duplicated routing match is untouched.
Turns MAX_CONFIG_BYTES into a Lazy<usize> static read from MAX_FEATURE_FLAG_FILTER_SIZE_BYTES with a 512 KiB default; also extracts field lists.
Seeders now call a public module-level read_flag_state from scorers.py instead of FlagStateUnchanged._read_state.
PiExtensionError is now defined as Pi's ExtensionError intersected with a type tag instead of a hand-written interface.
Adds a field-level validate_short_link_domain on the serializer and removes the create()-only check, so PUT/PATCH are validated.
Removes the redundant enable/disable menu item and adds a reentry guard to the toggle listener; duplicate flow is not changed.
Replaces the shutdown budget consts with envconfig fields plus accessors and a startup validate_shutdown_budgets check.
Imports USAGE_EVENT_NAMES and passes the decide/local event names as query parameters instead of hardcoded SQL strings.
Adds summarizeDescriptionChange with lowercase fragments; describeDescriptionChange now returns summary too and insight/dashboard describers use it.
Only edits a comment and catches RecursionError in _encoded_size; the operator classification sets are not moved to a shared home.
Renames the MCP tool inbox-reports-get-inbox to self-driving-inbox-get and updates its title, description and generated definitions.
